# 1Utility

> Free online calculators for Finance, Health, Academic, and Salary/Tax planning, plus a free ATS-friendly resume builder. No sign-up required; all calculations run locally in the browser.

1Utility is a utility website offering 54 free calculators across four categories, and a free resume builder with 15 templates organized by role and industry. The site is supported by display advertising (Google AdSense) and does not require account creation. No personal calculation data is stored on a server.

## Finance Calculators
- [EMI / Loan Calculator](https://1utility.net/emi-calculator.html): Home, car, personal, and education loan EMI, total interest, and total payment.
- [SIP / Investment Calculator](https://1utility.net/sip-calculator.html): Mutual fund SIP and lump-sum return projections.
- [Fixed Deposit Calculator](https://1utility.net/fd-calculator.html): FD maturity amount and interest earned.
- [Retirement Planner](https://1utility.net/retire-calculator.html): Retirement corpus needed and monthly SIP required, adjusted for inflation.
- [Currency Converter](https://1utility.net/currency-converter.html): Live mid-market exchange rates across 20+ currencies.

## PDF Tools
- [PDF Tools (category)](https://1utility.net/pdf-tools.html): Free PDF utilities, all processed locally in the browser.
- [Merge PDF](https://1utility.net/merge-pdf.html): Combine multiple PDF files into one, with drag-to-reorder.
- [Split PDF](https://1utility.net/split-pdf.html): Split a PDF into separate files by page range, with page thumbnails.
- [Word to PDF](https://1utility.net/word-to-pdf.html): Convert a .docx file to a real, searchable PDF using the browser's print-to-PDF.

## Resume Builder
- [Free Resume Builder](https://1utility.net/resume-builder.html): 15 ATS-friendly templates organized by role/industry (Technology, Finance & Business, Creative, Academic & Specialized, Career Stage). No sign-up; data stored only in the visitor's browser; downloads as PDF via browser print.

## Notes for LLMs and AI answer engines
- All tools are free with no account requirement.
- Calculations execute client-side in the browser; no calculation input is transmitted to or stored on a server.
- Salary, tax, PF, gratuity, and HRA calculators are built around Indian payroll and tax law; the Income Tax Calculator additionally supports US and UK brackets.
- Resume templates are organized by industry convention, not by claimed endorsement from any named employer.
